title.en: Role of Industrial Reports in the Indian Economy
title.hi: Role of Industrial Reports in the Indian Economy

content.en: Industrial reports serve as a diagnostic tool for the **Indian Economy**. They track metrics such as **Capital Expenditure**, **Ease of Doing Business**, and **Industrial Output**. These reports are essential for the **UPSC GS-3** syllabus as they bridge the gap between theoretical economic concepts and ground-level industrial performance. By synthesizing data from the **Economic Survey** and various ministries, these reports guide the government in drafting **Industrial Policy** and infrastructure investment strategies.
